fact: On 2 October 2026 the UMOA Council of Ministers gave a favourable opinion to participation of the BCEAO and UMOA commercial banks in PAPSS, following a six-month pilot announced in July 2026 and linking PAPSS to the BCEAO instant payment platform PI-SPI launched on 30 September 2025.
title: Paiements africains : le feu vert qui pourrait contourner le dollar
